messages:
Maya (PM): Quick design review thread — model catalog compare table. Main asks: make version pinning discoverable and accessible, ensure performance badges are announced to screen readers, and tidy keyboard flow. Figma link: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/model-catalog (proto) Ethan (Design): 👍 agree. Current pin is just a 12px star with tooltip. No aria-label and no keyboard affordance. Proposal: move pin earlier in the row (left of model name) and add a visible left accent when pinned. Priya (Frontend): Tab order note — right now focus jumps: checkbox -> name -> actions -> pin (if you scroll). We should surface pin immediately after checkbox so keyboard users can find it. Implementation: make pin focusable with tabindex=0 and ensure Enter/Space toggles it. Samir (Eng-ML): Perf badges question: we show p50/p95/p99 small chips. Are these purely visual? We should include sr-only text for a11y: e.g. "p95 latency 120ms" hidden visually but readable by screen readers. Maya (PM): Good call. Also microcopy: when user pins, show a toast "Pinned model v2.4 — Compare will default to this version" with an "Unpin" CTA. That toast should be announced via aria-live="polite" so SR users get feedback. Priya (Frontend): Small code snippet proposal for the toast: ```
Pinned model v2.4. Use Unpin to revert.
``` Also recommend debouncing the live region to avoid repeated announcements during rapid toggles. Ethan (Design): Contrast nit — badge background currently #F6F8FA with text #6B7280. At 12px this fails AA for small text. Options: bolder font-weight for badge text, darker text color, or slightly darker bg. Also consider adding an icon for each badge (clock) to help scanning. Constance (QA): I'll run VoiceOver and NVDA once a prototype is available. Quick tests I want: announce for pin/unpin, badge text read as "p99 latency 240 milliseconds", focus order with Shift+Tab, and keyboard shortcut behavior. Samir (Eng-ML): Implementation notes: Adding sr-only spans is cheap. For keyboard shortcut idea (Maya), we can scope shortcuts to when table has focus to avoid conflicts. Use keydown handler and check document.activeElement is inside the table. Maya (PM): Shortcut idea: 'P' to pin the currently focused row. Maybe lowercase 'p' when table focused. Does that feel discoverable or too risky? Priya (Frontend): I'm OK with 'P' as long as we show the hint on hover/focus: tooltip or small helper text "Press P to pin". Also implement using element.setAttribute('aria-keyshortcuts', 'p') for supported ATs. Ethan (Design): Visual affordance: when pinned, add a 3px left accent in accent color + a clear pinned icon and change row background slightly. That reduces reliance on the star alone. Samir (Eng-ML): Make sure the star uses role="button", aria-pressed="true|false", and responds to Space/Enter. Keydown handler must call event.preventDefault() for Space to avoid scroll. Constance (QA): Also test high-contrast mode and keyboard-only nav. If pinned state only uses color, we need an additional indicator (icon or text) for colorblind users. Maya (PM): Acceptance criteria I want before sign-off: - SR announces badge values and pin/unpin action. - Keyboard can pin/unpin via Enter/Space and 'P' shortcut scoped to table. - Visual pin state not conveyed by color alone (icon + accent border). - Badge contrast meets AA for small text or we use bolder text. - Toasts announced via aria-live and deduped. Ethan (Design): I'll update the Figma with the new pin placement, accent border, and badge iconography by EOD Wednesday. I'll add copy variants for the toast and tooltip. Priya (Frontend): I'll prototype the tabindex change and aria attributes on a staging build. ETA: Thurs morning. Will include aria-keyshortcuts and a11y utilities. Samir (Eng-ML): I'll add the sr-only text generation in the metrics rendering path so badges include both visible and sr text. Also will add a small debounce for live region updates. Constance (QA): On it — will prepare a test matrix and quick script for NVDA/VoiceOver runs once you drop the build. Maya (PM): Thanks all — tagging next steps: @Ethan update figma, @Priya prototype, @Samir add sr text and debounce, @Constance QA plan. Re-check here when ready. :thumbsup: Ethan (Design): On it. Priya (Frontend): Will add a short PR description for reviewers explaining keyboard and aria changes. Constance (QA): I'll schedule a quick 20m sync to demo SR results after prototype. Maya (PM): Great — closing thread for now. If anyone hits blocking issues ping me directly.
